CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinates+color), an explicit organization/presentation pattern (node entries across current/candidate), and separate origin/status metadata are all present for the same identified content/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition tied to the identified content's presentation or access is stated.

C.rationale: The report lists identified contents (color-labelled coordinate sets) with attributes (red/blue) and explicit record paths.

D.rationale: Each identified content entry is accompanied by separate origin/status metadata, distinguishing content identity from its status/source.

O.rationale: The text describes how contents are represented across named nodes/records (current and candidate nodes), i.e. their organized presentation/access.
